info.title: Kanso API
info.description:
Local-first voice control. The web app talks to this API; the Tavus PAL and Alexa+ talk to the MCP endpoint at /mcp, which is not part of this document.

Identity: there is no login. POST /api/onboard returns a user id, and every other call takes that id in the body or query. When it is left out, the most recently onboarded user is used.

Live updates: subscribe to GET /api/events for server-sent events instead of polling.

Errors: failures return { statusCode, message, error }.

candidates.description: Closest matches when error is DEVICE_NOT_FOUND.

hubId.description: Defaults to the home's first hub.

applied.description: Devices whose pending command was replayed once the hub came back.

clear.description: Speech enhancement before transcription (Desert Ant Clear).

intent.description: The spoken request this tool was generated from.

intent.example: check my front door lock and alert me if it is unlocked after 10 PM

daily.description: Local 24-hour time the automation runs on its own every day.
